windows-std.name: The standard library and the collector, gated on Windows

steps.name: What this machine has
steps.run:
if (-not (Get-Command make -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
  choco install make --no-progress -y
}
$lib = (crystal env CRYSTAL_LIBRARY_PATH).Trim()
$llvm = (Get-Content "$lib\llvm_VERSION")[0].Trim()
"CRYSTAL_LIBRARY_PATH=$lib" | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $env:GITHUB_ENV
"LLVM_VERSION=$llvm" | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $env:GITHUB_ENV

steps.name: Build the fork's compiler, then `iyi`
steps.run:
make -f Makefile.win crystal || exit /b 1
make -f Makefile.win iyi

steps.name: The collector's gates, on Windows
steps.run:
failed=""
for gate in bench/arena_exercise.sh bench/root_exercise.sh \
            bench/mark_exercise.sh bench/sweep_exercise.sh \
            bench/collect_trigger.sh bench/thread_exercise.sh \
            bench/parallel_mark.sh bench/concurrent_mark.sh; do
  bash bench/bounded_gate.sh 15 "$gate" || failed="$failed $gate"
done
[ -z "$failed" ] || { echo "failed:$failed"; exit 1; }

steps.name: SQLite, for the driver the gates bind
steps.run:
$zip = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'sqlite-dll-win-x64-3530400.zip'
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-dll-win-x64-3530400.zip' -OutFile $zip
$hash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $zip).Hash.ToLower()
if ($hash -ne '8b959b7eff4a81f6a62fc3468f9273e5cfe78d4a927e62215aed231b654fb104') {
  throw "sqlite.org's zip is not the one pinned here: $hash"
}
$dir = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'sqlite'
Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $dir -Force
lib /nologo /def:"$dir\sqlite3.def" /machine:x64 /out:"$dir\sqlite3.lib"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "lib could not make sqlite3.lib from sqlite3.def" }
"LIB=$env:LIB;$dir" | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $env:GITHUB_ENV
$dir | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $env:GITHUB_PATH
